published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: An accounting logic error caused the nextRewards calculation to be inflated, resulting in overpayment of rewards.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: The syncRewards() function is not called to synchronize rewards before executing withdrawal operations.

    26 | import { ERC20, ERC4626, xERC4626 } from "ERC4626/xERC4626.sol";
    27 | import "openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
    28 | 
    29 | /// @title Vault token for staked frxETH
    30 | /// @notice Is a vault that takes frxETH and gives you sfrxETH erc20 tokens
    31 | /** @dev Exchange rate between frxETH and sfrxETH floats, you can convert your sfrxETH for more frxETH over time.
    32 |     Exchange rate increases as the frax msig mints new frxETH corresponding to the staking yield and drops it into the vault (sfrxETH contract).
    33 |     There is a short time period, “cycles” which the exchange rate increases linearly over. This is to prevent gaming the exchange rate (MEV).
    34 |     The cycles are constant length, but calling syncRewards slightly into a would-be cycle keeps the same would-be endpoint (so cycle ends are every X seconds).
    35 |     Someone must call syncRewards, which queues any new frxETH in the contract to be added to the redeemable amount.
    36 |     sfrxETH adheres to ERC-4626 vault specs 
    37 |     Mint vs Deposit
    38 |     mint() - deposit targeting a specific number of sfrxETH out
    39 |     deposit() - deposit knowing a specific number of frxETH in */
    40 | contract sfrxETH is xERC4626, ReentrancyGuard {
    41 |     /* ========== CONSTRUCTOR ========== */
    42 |     constructor(ERC20 _underlying, uint32 _rewardsCycleLength)
    43 |         ERC4626(_underlying, "Staked Frax Ether", "sfrxETH")
    44 |         xERC4626(_rewardsCycleLength)
    45 |     {}
    46 | 
    47 |     /// @notice Syncs rewards if applicable beforehand. Noop if otherwise 
    48 |     function beforeWithdraw(uint256 assets, uint256 shares) internal override {
    49 |         super.beforeWithdraw(assets, shares); // call xERC4626's beforeWithdraw first
    50 |         if (block.timestamp >= rewardsCycleEnd) { syncRewards(); } 
    51 |     }
    52 | 
    53 |     /// @notice How much frxETH is 1E18 sfrxETH worth. Price is in ETH, not USD
    54 |     function pricePerShare() public view returns (uint256) {
    55 |         return convertToAssets(1e18);
    56 |     }
    57 | 
    58 |     /// @notice Approve and deposit() in one transaction
    59 |     function depositWithSignature(
    60 |         uint256 assets,
    61 |         address receiver,
    62 |         uint256 deadline,
    63 |         bool approveMax,
    64 |         uint8 v,
    65 |         bytes32 r,
    66 |         bytes32 s
    67 |     ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {
    68 |         uint256 amount = approveMax ? type(uint256).max : assets;
    69 |         asset.permit(msg.sender, address(this), amount, deadline, v, r, s);
    70 |         return (deposit(assets, receiver));
    71 |     }
    72 | 
    73 |     /// @notice Approve and mint() in one transaction
    74 |     /// @dev Similar to the deposit method, but you give it the number of shares you want instead.
